affected.note: Personal data of 62,575 people (name, address, birthdate, email, phone, purchase history), including credit card data of 14,256 people who bought between 2021-01-22 and 2022-10-03. ScanNetSecurity reported the card data as leaked; Mynavi described the data as possibly leaked.

summary.en: Tomato, which runs the fabric mail-order site Tomato Online Shop, reported that attackers exploited a vulnerability and planted malicious files on the site. Credit card data of 14,256 customers and other personal data of 62,575 people were affected.
summary.ja: 生地・布の通販サイト「トマトオンラインショップ」を運営するトマトは、サイトの脆弱性を突かれ不正なファイルを設置されたと公表した。14,256人分のクレジットカード情報と、62,575人分の個人情報が対象となった。

sources.title: 生地・布の通販サイト「トマトオンラインショップ」へ不正アクセス、14,256名のカード情報が漏えい
